But I didn’t quit.

A first-of-its-kind AI-powered software that helps marketing and sales teams automatically audit and monitor their advertising for compliance.

Today, through my new holding company Ugentic AI, I invest in and partner with AI & Martech SaaS companies, using the same growth strategies that helped scale my past businesses.

snippet.title: Journey With The Hintons
snippet.description:
My mission is simple: to help YOU prosper and live life on your terms. Because if I could rewrite my story, so can you.

I got my Master’s degree, became a Nurse Practitioner, and built the ‘successful’ career. But here’s the truth — I was drowning in six figures of student loan debt, chained to a 9-5 that drained me, and living a life that didn’t reflect my God-given purpose.

So what did I do? I QUIT. I trusted God and rebuilt my life from the ground up, not with titles or degrees, but with freedom, purpose, and prosperity.
